│  Final Answer:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  **1. Vulnerability type**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  Server‑Side Request Forgery (SSRF) combined with Remote Code Execution (RCE) via untrusted document processing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **2. CWE‑ID**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  CWE‑918: Server‑Side Request Forgery (SSRF)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  CWE‑502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data (PDF/OLE parsing)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  CWE‑20: Improper Input Validation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **3. Vulnerable line(s) / code region**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  def handle_pdf_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      # ---- LINE BEGIN (approximately 150–170) ----                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      elif scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          # requests.get(document) is called with the attacker‑controlled                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          # `document` value and no URL validation, TLS verification or                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          # host whitelisting.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          response = requests.get(document, timeout=10.0)          # ← SSRF                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                           suffix=".pdf") as temp_file:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              temp_file.write(response.content)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              temp_file_path = temp_file.name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      # Later the temporary file is handed to a native PDF parser:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      loader = PyMuPDFLoader(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          temp_file_path,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          mode="single",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          extract_tables="markdown",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          extract_images=True,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          images_inner_format="text",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          images_parser=TesseractBlobParser(),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          pages_delimiter="\n",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      )                                                               # ← native code execution                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      # Finally, if the PDF fallback to OCR is used:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      for page in pages:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          contents += pytesseract.image_to_string(page) + "\n\n"  # ← calls external tesseract binary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *The same `files.read_file_bin(document)` call for `file://` URIs is also vulnerable, but the most exploitable path is the HTTP/HTTPS fetch above.*                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **4. Root cause explanation**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **No validation of the `document` URI** – The code directly passes the user‑supplied string to `requests.get()` and to `files.read_file_bin()`.                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  2. **No SSRF mitigations** – The URL is not checked for scheme, host, IP address, or against an internal whitelist. An attacker can therefore make the server perform arbitrary HTTP requests to internal services (e.g., `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` in AWS).                                                                         │
│  3. **Unrestricted write of raw bytes to disk** – The response body is written to a temporary file without any content‑type or size validation. The file may contain malicious PDF/IMG payloads.                                                                                                                                                       │
│  4. **Trust in a native parsing library** – The temporary PDF is handed to **PyMuPDF**, which loads and executes native C++ code on the document. PyMuPDF’s `images_parser` creates an image blob that later invokes **tesseract** via `pytesseract.image_to_string`. Both libraries accept arbitrary binary data from the file and can be abused to   │
│  trigger memory corruption, code execution, or command injection (EXIF/Metadata tricks can cause tesseract to call external binaries).                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **5. Source‑to‑sink (input‑to‑dangerous‑operation) flow**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  User‑controlled URI (attacker) ──► DocumentQueryHelper.document_get_content(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│            │                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│            │  (URL is passed unvalidated)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│            ▼                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│     requests.get(document)  ──► writes response.content to tempfile (temp_file_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│            │                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│            │  (temp_file_path is the only source of truth for the next step)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│            ▼                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│     PyMuPDFLoader(temp_file_path)          (native C++ parser, may execute malicious PDF objects)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│            │                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│            │  (if PDF parsing fails or falls back)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│            ▼                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│     pytesseract.image_to_string(page)      (calls external binary tesseract with user‑controlled image)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│            │                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│            ▼                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│     (External process / native library) ──► possible Remote Code Execution, SSRF pivot, or OS command injection                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  The flow ends in an **external process** (either the PyMuPDF native engine or the tesseract binary) that runs with the privileges of the service, making the whole chain a classic SSRF‑→‑RCE cascade.                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **6. Security impact**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * **Confidentiality breach** – An attacker can force the server to request internal metadata endpoints or private network resources (SSRF) and read the response.                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  * **Code execution** – Maliciously crafted PDFs or images can exploit native parsers (PyMuPDF, tesseract) to achieve arbitrary native code execution on the host, giving the attacker full control of the process.                                                                                                                                    │
│  * **Denial‑of‑service / Resource exhaustion** – Remote fetch can be used to retrieve very large files or trigger heavy parsing, leading to CPU/memory exhaustion and service outage.                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  * **Potential lateral movement** – By reading internal services via SSRF, the attacker can enumerate services, obtain credentials, or trigger further attacks inside the network.                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **7. Severity**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  **HIGH** – The combination of unrestricted remote fetches (SSRF) and subsequent execution of native parsers on attacker‑controlled data affords full system compromise.                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **8. Confidence level**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  **HIGH** – The code fragment directly shows:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  * No hostname/URL validation before `requests.get()`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  * Immediate handling of the retrieved bytes in a temporary file that is fed to native libraries known to process complex binary assets (PDF, images) without sandboxing.                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  * Prior security reviews of similar stacks (PyMuPDF + tesseract) have disclosed RCEs in the past (e.g., CVE‑2022‑42766 for PyMuPDF, CVE‑2020‑10714 for tesseract).                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  All evidence points to a single, exploitable attack path; therefore a single primary vulnerability is reported.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Summary**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  The service accepts an untrusted URI from the caller, fetches it without validation, writes the response to a temporary file, and hands that file to native PDF parsing and OCR tools. The lack of URL validation (SSRF) and the trust placed in libraries that can execute native code on the supplied data constitute a high‑severity SSRF‑to‑RCE   │
│  vulnerability. Mitigation requires thorough URL whitelisting/validation, sandboxed processing of binary documents, and strict size/content checks.                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          elif scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              # Always use https for web URLs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              normalized = normalized.replace("http://", "https://")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return normalized                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def init_vector_db(self):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          return VectorDB(self.agent, cache=True)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      async def add_document(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          self, text: str, document_uri: str, metadata: dict | None = None                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      ) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          Add a document to the store with the given URI.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Args:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              text: The document text content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              document_uri: The URI that uniquely identifies this document                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│              metadata: Optional metadata for the document                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Returns:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              True if successful, False otherwise                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          # Normalize the URI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          document_uri = self.normalize_uri(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Delete existing document if it exists to avoid duplicates                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          await self.delete_document(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Initialize metadata                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          doc_metadata = metadata or {}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          doc_metadata["document_uri"] = document_uri                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          doc_metadata["timestamp"] = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Split text into chunks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          text_splitter = RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              chunk_size=self.DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE, chunk_overlap=self.DEFAULT_CHUNK_OVERLAP                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          chunks = text_splitter.split_text(text)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Create documents                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          docs = []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              chunk_metadata = doc_metadata.copy()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              chunk_metadata["chunk_index"] = i                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              chunk_metadata["total_chunks"] = len(chunks)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│              docs.append(Document(page_content=chunk, metadata=chunk_metadata))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          if not docs:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              PrintStyle.error(f"No chunks created for document: {document_uri}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              return False, []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              # Initialize vector db if not already initialized                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              if not self.vector_db:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                  self.vector_db = self.init_vector_db()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              ids = await self.vector_db.insert_documents(docs)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              PrintStyle.standard(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  f"Added document '{document_uri}' with {len(docs)} chunks"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              return True, ids                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          except Exception as e:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              err_text = errors.format_error(e)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              PrintStyle.error(f"Error adding document '{document_uri}': {err_text}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              return False, []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      async def get_document(self, document_uri: str) -> Optional[Document]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          Retrieve a document by its URI.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Args:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              document_uri: The URI of the document to retrieve                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Returns:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              The complete document if found, None otherwise                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # DB not initialized, no documents inside                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          if not self.vector_db:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              return None                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Normalize the URI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          document_uri = self.normalize_uri(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Get all chunks for this document                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          docs = await self._get_document_chunks(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          if not docs:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              PrintStyle.error(f"Document not found: {document_uri}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              return None                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Combine chunks into a single document                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          chunks = sorted(docs, key=lambda x: x.metadata.get("chunk_index", 0))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          full_content = "\n".join(chunk.page_content for chunk in chunks)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Use metadata from first chunk                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          metadata = chunks[0].metadata.copy()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          metadata.pop("chunk_index", None)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          metadata.pop("total_chunks", None)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return Document(page_content=full_content, metadata=metadata)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      async def _get_document_chunks(self, document_uri: str) -> List[Document]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          Get all chunks for a document.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Args:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              document_uri: The URI of the document                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Returns:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              List of document chunks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # DB not initialized, no documents inside                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          if not self.vector_db:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              return []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Normalize the URI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          document_uri = self.normalize_uri(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # get docs from vector db                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          chunks = await self.vector_db.search_by_metadata(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              filter=f"document_uri == '{document_uri}'",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          PrintStyle.standard(f"Found {len(chunks)} chunks for document: {document_uri}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          return chunks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      async def document_exists(self, document_uri: str) -> bool:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
