│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 172.16.0.0/12                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      if 0xAC10 <= int_ip <= 0xAC1FFF:        # 172.16.*.* – 172.31.*.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          return True                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 192.168.0.0/16                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      if int_ip >> 16 == 0xC0A8:                # 192.168.*.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          return True                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 169.254.0.0/16 (link‑local)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      if int_ip >> 16 == 0xA9FE:                # 169.254.*.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          return True                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Private (RFC1918) already covered, but also check 100.64.0.0/10 (CGNAT) and 100.128.0.0/10 (CGNAT)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      # omitted for brevity – you can import ipaddress and use ipaddress.ip_address(...).is_private                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def _is_safe_url(raw_url: str) -> bool:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Very strict: allow only http/https, reject any IP literal, any DNS name that resolves                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      to a private network, and reject any URL that contains a scheme other than http(s).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(raw_url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          netloc = parsed.netloc                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          if not netloc:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Strip credentials – e.g. user:pass@host.com                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          host = netloc.split("@")[-1]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # If host is an IP literal, reject it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              ipaddr = socket.gethostbyname(host)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              if _is_private_ip(ipaddr):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                  return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          except socket.gaierror:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              # NXDOMAIN, could be a hostile domain that will later be blocked.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Resolve the host and double‑check it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              resolved_ip = socket.gethostbyname(host)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              if resolved_ip != ipaddr:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                  # Different results for IPv4 vs IPv6 – just reject for safety.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          except socket.gaierror:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return True                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  # OCR handling – fully sandboxed -----------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  def _run_ocr_on_image(image_bytes: bytes) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Calls `tesseract` inside a Docker container that never sees the host filesystem.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      The container is started for each call, receives the image over stdin,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      writes stdout JSON to stdout, then exits.  Any crash stays inside the container.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      if not image_bytes:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          raise ValueError("Empty image data for OCR")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Write image to a temporary file *inside a tmpfs* that Docker can see.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      # NOTE: Docker will mount a tmpfs volume at /tmp/ocr and the entry dir                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      # is owned by UID 1000 (non‑root inside the container).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".png") as tmp_img:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          tmp_img.write(image_bytes)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          tmp_path = Path(tmp_img.name)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # The container image we will use – it must contain `tesseract` and `python`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      # Building it once in CI is out of scope; we assume it's called `ocr‑sandbox:latest`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      container = "ocr-sandbox:latest"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Build the container command                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      cmd = [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          "docker", "run",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          "--rm",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          "-i",                     # give us stdin                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          "-e", "TZ=UTC",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          "--memory=200m",          # cgroup memory limit                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          "--pids-limit=64",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          "--network=none",         # no outbound network                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          "--mount", f"type=tmpfs,destination=/tmp/ocr,readonly",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          "--mount", f"type=tmpfs,destination=/tmp/pip,readonly",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          container,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          "python", "-",            # read stdin (base64) → print plain‑text result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      ]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Prepare stdin for the container: we send the path to the image file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      # The wrapper script (inside the container) will read that path, call tesseract,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      # and emit the plain‑text result on stdout.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      stdin_data = f"PATH={tmp_path}\n".encode()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Run the Docker command                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      proc = subprocess.run(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          cmd,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          input=stdin_data,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          stdout=subprocess.PIPE,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          stderr=subprocess.PIPE,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          timeout=30,                # hard timeout for the OCR binary + container spin‑up                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      if proc.returncode != 0:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          # We deliberately hide native stack traces – a clean abort is enough.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          abort(500, description="OCR failed")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      # The wrapper prints a single line: the extracted plain‑text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      result = proc.stdout.decode().strip()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      if not result:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          raise ValueError("OCR returned empty text")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      return result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # Clean up the temp file we created above                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      finally:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              tmp_path.unlink()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              pass                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  # Core class – the public API ---------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  class DocumentQueryHelper:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Public contract:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          query_text(url_or_path: str) -> str                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      The method now performs all the validation, size checks and sandboxed OCR.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      def __init__(self, doc_root: Path = Path("/safe/documents")):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          self.doc_root = doc_root.resolve()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # -------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      # Public entry point                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      # -------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      def query_text(self, identifier: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          If `identifier` is a URL and passes the safety checks we stream it,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          otherwise we treat it as a local file path and enforce the doc_root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if "://" in identifier:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              return self._process_remote(identifier)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              return self._process_local(identifier)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # -------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      # Remote (URL) handling                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      # -------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      def _process_remote(self, raw_url: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          # 1️⃣ Validate the URL with our deny‑list implementation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          if not _is_safe_url(raw_url):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              abort(400, description="Unsafe URL")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # 2️⃣ Use a streaming request – we do **not** load the whole body into RAM.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          #    We will enforce the size limit with the `StreamLimited` wrapper.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              resp = requests.get(raw_url, stream=True, timeout=10)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              if not resp.ok:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                  abort(502, description=f"Upstream returned {resp.status_code}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          except requests.RequestException as exc:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              abort(502, description=f"Network error: {exc}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Peek at the content‑type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          ct = resp.headers.get("Content-Type", "").split(";")[0]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          max_allowed = self._max_bytes_for_mime(ct)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Wrap the iterator with a size check                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          stream = self._limited_stream(resp.iter_content(chunk_size=64 * 1024), max_allowed)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Choose a temporary directory that lives *inside* the container’s mount namespace.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          # The directory will be automatically removed on exit.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="downloaded_", dir=None) as tmp_dir:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              tmp_path = Path(tmp_dir) / "doc.bin"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Write the streamed content to disk.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  with open(tmp_path, "wb") as f:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                      for chunk in stream:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                          if not chunk:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                              continue                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                          f.write(chunk)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              except OSError:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                  abort(500, description="File system error while saving temporary document")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Determine what we have: pdf? image? fallback to generic binary parsing?                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              content_type = ct                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              if content_type not in MAX_CONTENT_BYTES:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                  # If the upstream did not give us a good mime, we can sniff.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                  # For brevity we just treat it as an unknown PDF.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  content_type = "application/pdf"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Load the file with the PDF library.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              return self._load_and_extract(tmp_path, content_type)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # -------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      # Local (file path) handling                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      # -------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      def _process_local(self, path_str: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          # Resolve the path *exactly*; symlink attacks are mitigated by                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          # pathlib.Path.resolve(strict=False) and then checking the doc_root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              p = Path(path_str).resolve(strict=True)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          except FileNotFoundError:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              abort(404, description="Path does not exist")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Enforce that p is *inside* self.doc_root                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              relative = p.relative_to(self.doc_root)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          except ValueError:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              abort(403, description="Path escapes the allowed document root")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Use the mime to fetch the size limit; fall back to generic 5 MiB.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          mime = self._detect_mime(p)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          max_allowed = self._max_bytes_for_mime(mime)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          if p.stat().st_size > max_allowed:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              abort(413, description=f"File larger than allowed {max_allowed} bytes for {mime}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Load + extract text                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          return self._load_and_extract(p, mime)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # -------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      # Helper: size limit per mime                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
